## Repository hygiene

- [ ] No real Telegram credentials, sessions, auth keys or phone numbers.
- [ ] No Apple signing assets, provisioning profiles, private keys or passwords.
- [ ] Commit identities and changed files were checked for personal data.
- [ ] Relevant licenses, notices and submodule references are preserved.
- [ ] Intentional runtime/build capability switches are explicit and tested; no feature is silently withheld by documentation-only policy.

A checkout, project generation, dependency resolution, Bazel query or build start is not proof of successful compilation.
